text:
Anya: Pushing a second pass on the rollout screen — focused on safer rollback flows and a compact timeline scrubber for quickly finding versions. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc987/rollout-safety (mockups attached). Thoughts on the safety-gate pattern?
Devon: Nice. The safety-gate idea (extra confirmation overlay + short delay) feels good. Two questions: is delay configurable? and how does it affect automation (CI triggered rollbacks)?
Priya: From product POV we should not surprise automation. Delays should only apply to manual actions. For manual rollback show a 5s countdown option + an optional typed confirm for high-impact rollbacks.
Sandeep: UX nit: the countdown should be cancellable and announce via ARIA when it starts and when it finishes. Also show the reason field (optional) so SREs can see context.
Oliver: For keyboard users, the overlay must trap focus and put focus on the primary destructive button after the typed-confirm is filled. Also add a `data-test` attr for e2e.
Kai: Backend: we'll add metadata `rollback.initiated_by`, `rollback.manual_delay_seconds`, `rollback.reason`. For automation, set `manual_delay_seconds=0`.
AccessibilityBot: Reminder: use role="alertdialog" for the safety overlay and ensure focus returns to the originating action after close. Provide skip links for the timeline scrubber.
Anya: timeline scrubber idea: small horizontal mini-timeline with thumbnails of snapshots; drag to scrub and preview metrics for each version. Does that seem feasible?
Devon: cool idea. Concern: scrubbing might fetch metrics which could be heavy. We should cache recent snapshots and show a lightweight placeholder while loading.
Priya: maybe only show metric deltas on hover, not for every scrub movement. That reduces noise. Also show an indicator if the previewed version is rolling or stable.
Sandeep: small copy suggestion for the rollout header: instead of 'Version history' try 'Deployment history & quick actions' — clearer for new users.
Anya: good call. Also considering a 'safety cushion' visual: if a version is older than X days, show a warning before rollback: "This version is >30 days old; configuration or dependencies may have changed."
Oliver: implementation note: wire the cushion rule to a feature flag so we can tune threshold. Also add telemetry event `ui.rollback_safety_shown`.
Kai: telemetry naming proposal: `deploy.rollback_request`, `deploy.rollback_confirmed`, `deploy.rollback_cancelled`, `ui.timeline_scrub`. Keep `deploy.*` for server events.
Devon: agree on names. Also localization: confirm button copy should be short and translatable. Avoid embedded variables in button text; use separate label and detail line for version.
Priya: what about animations? Some want a fade-in for the overlay, but it can confuse motion-sensitive users. We should respect prefers-reduced-motion.
AccessibilityBot: Yes. Detect `prefers-reduced-motion` and default to no animation. Also ensure all interactive elements have 44x44 touch targets for mobile.
Anya: mobile: stacked layout with timeline scrubbing hidden behind an "History" sheet. Gerrit: we lose context if we hide too much. Thoughts?
Sandeep: keep an affordance to 'peek' the timeline on mobile (small row that expands) rather than a full-screen sheet. Faster access.
Oliver: Regarding rollback copy, propose: Confirm modal title: 'Confirm rollback to v{version}' Body: 'Rolling back routes traffic to {version}. Some requests may be retried.' Primary button: 'Rollback now' Secondary: 'Cancel' For >60% traffic, require typing the exact version id.
Devon: prefer 'Rollback now' vs 'Confirm' — more action-oriented. Also add a brief muted line: 'This operation is logged and notifies on-call.'
Priya: add a checkbox option: 'Also trigger cache invalidation' default off. Many rollback flows need cache refresh.
Kai: backend will support `rollback.trigger_cache_purge=true` in the API. We'll gate it by permission.
Anya: contrast/accessibility check: timeline labels use medium-gray on white; change to dark-gray for text and keep muted gray only for meta. Also ensure status icons have text fallback.
AccessibilityBot: Also run color-blindness simulation for the status palette. Use patterns (icons/text) not just color.
Devon: final UX ask: in the header show a small 'last deploy health' badge with 1h latency and error rate deltas. If the health is degraded, surface a recommended action (suggest rollback) but not pre-checked.
Sandeep: agree. Add an inline 'Suggested action' callout that can be dismissed for 24h. Telemetry: `ui.suggestion_dismissed`.
Anya: thanks all — I'll update Figma with: safety-gate overlay variants (countdown and typed confirm), timeline scrubber compact mode, updated copy for mobile, and the 'suggested action' callout. Expect a new frame in ~3 hours.
Oliver: frontend will add keyboard flow doc and the `data-test` hooks once Figma lands.
Kai: backend will draft the API shape and permission checks.
Priya: I'll write the product blurb for the release notes and mention the cache purge checkbox.
Anya: tagging follow-ups: @Devon for telemetry, @Mareda for final a11y sweep (Mareda is OOO but please pick a backup if needed), and @Kai for API review.
AccessibilityBot: Added checklist: focus management, alert roles, reduced motion, ARIA labels, contrast, touch targets, typed-confirm accessibility.
Priya: documented edge-case: if rollback target is deleted (artifact expired) show 'Version unavailable' and provide link to recreate or fallback.
Devon: cool. If no blockers by EOD we'll move to implementation. :rocket:
